title: Honest Toil — Zeal of Zenithar (300 Trade Bars)
description: Zeal of Zenithar daily. First 'Honest Toil' completion each day = 300 Trade Bars + a legendary Zenithar's Parcel (account-wide, once/day — extra runs give only epic parcels, no more bars). Do it first thing on The Death of Chains. Quest from Amminus Varo at the Belkarth festival grounds. Event ends Jul 8 10am ET.

title: Master Writs — Zeal of Zenithar (1 epic box per discipline)
description: Zeal of Zenithar daily: complete one Master Writ in each crafting discipline (BS, Clothier, WW, JC, Alchemy, Enchanting, Provisioning) for an epic Zenithar's Parcel each — per discipline, per account, per day. On Erin. Manual / non-auto-tracked. Event ends Jul 8 10am ET.
